exposure: cesarean delivery (as a risk of standard management)
cohort: This abstract discusses general patient populations affected by vasa previa, rather than a specific study cohort.
finding: The management of vasa previa is evolving towards personalized strategies, with growing evidence supporting outpatient monitoring, delayed delivery, and emerging techniques like fetoscopic laser photocoagulation (FLP) to optimize maternal and fetal outcomes, though FLP remains investigational.
mod_finding: Fetoscopic laser photocoagulation (FLP) in selected cases of types II and III vasa previa could facilitate term delivery and vaginal birth.
